ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Articles L. 561-1 to L. 561-50 and R. 561-1 to R. 561-36 of the French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier), transposing EU Directive (EU) 2015/849 and its amendments; Articles L. 223-1 et seq. and R. 123-166 of the French Commercial Code for the declaration of beneficial owners to the Registre du commerce et des sociétés (RCS); Law No. 2018-898 of 23 October 2018 (Loi Pacte) reinforcing the Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs and the said register's operating decree No. 2018-1103; CJEU Judgment of 22 November 2022, C-37/20 WM, restricting general public access to beneficial-ownership data; and the French monetary sanctions regime administered by Tracfin under Article L. 151-3 CMF.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access: post-CJEU, the French beneficial-owner register is accessible to competent authorities (Tracfin, French tax, customs, and supervision authorities) and to AML/CFT obliged entities conducting statutory due diligence; no general public access is available.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and commercial register extract of the direct foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registrar of the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Hague Convention of 5 October 1961); consular legalization required only if the country of origin is not a Hague member

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized executed Articles of Association of the ultimate foreign parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or competent public registrar of the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies of all UBOs and proposed SARL managers (gérants)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority or notary of the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or authentication by a French consular authority

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing and criminal-record extract (non-condamnation) of the proposed gérant
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent judicial or registry authority of the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney appointing the French incorporation agent and registered-office representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary of the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds affidavit for the capital contribution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed bank of the country of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, proposed managers, directors, and authorized signatories against (i) the EU consolidated financial sanctions list, (ii) the UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, (iii) the OFAC SDN list for all USD-denominated wire and ACH settlement rails, (iv) Tracfin national restrictive measures and judicial asset-freeze orders, and (v) Interpol notices. Politically exposed persons are identified and handled in accordance with Articles L. 561-10-2 and R. 561-18 to R. 561-22-1 of the French Monetary and Financial Code, including the 12-month post-cessation risk-based treatment. Adverse matches trigger senior-management approval, enhanced due diligence, and, where required, a Tracfin declaration under Article L. 561-15 CMF.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Formalités des entreprises — Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises operated by INPI (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr); name availability is verified against the RCS via Infogreffe and the INPI industrial-property database (data.inpi.fr).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Article 2 of the French Constitution and Law No. 94-665 of 4 August 1994 (Loi Toubon) require the corporate name to be expressed in French or in Latin-script transliteration. Foreign words are permissible only where a French abridged name or sigle is included, no misleading public-order connotation arises, and all corporate instruments bear the legal form SARL or Société à Responsabilité Limitée together with the share capital amount and registered-office address per Articles L. 223-1 and R. 123-49 of the French Commercial Code.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banque / Bank (prior ministerial authorization and ACPR licensing)
France / République / National(e) (State-sponsorship connotation; prior authorization)
Ministère / Préfecture / Mairie / Gendarmerie / Sécurité (public-authority connotation)
Avocat / Expert-Comptable / Notaire / Médecin (reserved regulated professions)
SAS / SA / EURL / EURLU (misleading corporate-form tokens)
ONG / Fondation (requires a specific legal form)
Courtier / Broker in regulated financial or insurance intermediation
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: France does not provide a statutory pre-incorporation name reservation; availability is assessed at the moment the incorporation file is deposited. If the registry officer rejects the name, the applicant may either re-deposit an amended name or apply to the presiding judge of the competent commercial court (juge des référés du Tribunal de commerce) for an order directing registration, per Articles L. 123-3 and R. 123-3 of the French Commercial Code; the same route applies to an RCS refusal. Where the objection arises as an INPI trademark refusal, the appeal lies to the Cour d'appel under Articles L. 411-4 and R. 411-19 of the French Intellectual Property Code within a two-month window. No filing fee is charged per rejected attempt, but each rejection delays the effective RCS registration date.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted in a qualified form. The SARL must have a registered office (siège social) in France, which may be supplied by a licensed domiciliation company under Articles L. 123-11-1 et seq. of the French Commercial Code, or initially at the manager's private residence for a limited statutory period. For intermodal ISO container fleet leasing, a purely virtual address is acceptable for registry purposes, provided the company maintains a reliable French address for service of process and for INSEE, URSSAF, customs, and tax correspondence, and retains sufficient corporate substance indicators for French tax residence.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: approximately 5% to 10% annual probability of an unannounced on-site inspection. Continental container-box leasing is classified Low_Risk_Standard for AML purposes; unannounced premises visits are not a routine control, but URSSAF, customs (douanes), and tax audit authorities may randomly select the company for documentary verification of fleet invoices, lease agreements, and banking flows.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Journal d'Annonces Légales licensed in the département of the registered office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory advertising tariff (décret No. 84-206), localized by département

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of Articles of Association (Statuts) and incorporation legal opinion
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark; fixed fee for a standard SARL structure

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered-office domiciliation agreement, initial annual term
Apostille and consular authentication of foreign documents bundle

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Included in the initial RCS deposit fee; no separate statutory charge

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L.210-1 to L.210-9 (general company provisions), L.223-1 to L.223-43 (SARL formation and management), and R.223-1 to R.223-22 (registration formalities).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce in the territorial jurisdiction of the registered office, accessed through the formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr or Infogreffe electronic guichet.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration de constitution d'une société (M0) filed together with the statuts and annexes.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital for a SARL (Article L.223-2 Code de commerce). The Articles of Association may set the capital freely, but the entire subscribed cash capital must be fully paid up and deposited in an escrow-account with a French bank or with the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations before registration. In-kind contributions must be delivered before signature of the statuts; if the contributions have an indeterminate value, a commissaire aux apports must report to the partners.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the founders subscribe in full to the issued share capital of the Company as set out in the Articles of Association, each share being fully paid up to the extent required by law, and the share subscriptions hereby approved. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office address at [●], France, as set forth in the Articles, is confirmed, and the Gérant may execute any lease and public filing required. FURTHER RESOLVED, that [●] is appointed as sole Manager (Gérant) for an indefinite term with full management powers under Article L.223-18 of the French Commercial Code. RESOLVED FURTHER, that all authorizations are granted to effect the M0 declaration and registration before the Greffe, and to open the corporate bank and cash accounts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Clearance and Drafting of Articles
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI (Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle) and Infogreffe RCS records via the Infogreffe online portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a search in the French trademark and corporate-name databases to verify no identical or confusingly similar name is used. Prepare the draft statuts (Articles of Association) in French, stating the corporate object as intermodal ISO shipping container box leasing and related services, the SARL form, the registered office, share capital, and the number of shares. Confirm the appointment of at least one partner and one Gérant.
required_dossiers: Name availability search report from INPI/Infogreffe
Draft Articles of Association (projet de statuts)
Partner attendance sheet / intent to subscribe statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a conflicting prior right is identified, amend the corporate name with a distinctive prefix and rerun the search before continuing to capital deposit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Cash Capital Deposit and Escrow Blocking
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French credit institution (bank) or otherwise Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary corporate-in-formation bank account and deposit the full subscribed cash capital. The SARL capital is 100% subscribed and paid on subscription; no instalments are permitted for cash contributions. Upon payment, obtain the bank's certificate of deposit of funds (attestation de dépôt des fonds), which is required for the M0 filing.
required_dossiers: Proof of registered-office address for KYC
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the account opening due to incomplete beneficial-owner information, supply the missing beneficial-owner and source-of-funds declarations. If the deposit cannot be made at a bank, use a notary escrow account and obtain a notarial attestation under Article L.223-7 Code de commerce.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Constitutive Assembly and Signature of Statuts
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: All founding partners (associés) and the proposed Gérant.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold a constitutive meeting to approve the Articles, fix the shareholding and capital deposit, adopt the First Board Resolution, and appoint the Gérant. Each partner or authorised proxy must sign the statuts. If any in-kind contribution exceeding the legal threshold is made, a commissaire aux apports must prepare a valuation report before signature, unless the valuation is wholly deemed reliable by unanimous partners in cases expressly permitted by law.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Greffe objects to a formal defect in the statuts, convene a new partners' meeting to adopt corrective resolutions. If an in-kind valuation report is missing, petition the President of the Commercial Court to appoint a commissaire aux apports under Article L.223-9 Code de commerce.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of Legal Notice in an Authorised Newspaper
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal d'annonces légales approved for the department where the registered office is located.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Insert a public legal notice in an authorised legal-notices newspaper. The notice must contain the company name, legal form (SARL), registered office, share capital, corporate object, duration and the Gérant's identity. Obtain the publisher's attestation de parution from the newspaper to include in the registration file.
required_dossiers: Registered office address and dated company name
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notice is published in a non-approved paper or the published text materially deviates from the final statuts, publish a corrected notice in the correct journal and obtain a fresh attestation before filing the M0.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of M0 Registration Dossier with the Commercial Court Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce through the formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr or Infogreffe guichet.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the M0 declaration together with the signed statuts, capital deposit certificate, legal notice attestation, identity and address documents of the Gérant, and proof of registered-office occupation. Pay the registry fee. Upon successful examination, the Greffe grants the K-bis extract of registration; the company acquires legal personality as of the registration date under Article L.210-6 Code de commerce.
required_dossiers: Certified true copy of the signed statuts
Attestation de parution en annonces légales
Act of appointment and acceptance of the Gérant
Identity and address proof of the Gérant
Justification of the registered-office address (lease or domiciliation agreement)
Declaration of non-conviction and compliance (représentant légal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Greffe issues a notice of irregularity, respond in writing within the 15-day regulatory period and file corrected annexes. In case of refusal of registration, appeal the refusal to the First President of the Cour d'appel within 15 days as provided for in Article L.210-4 Code de commerce.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Identification Codes and Beneficial Ownership Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INSEE via the SIRENE registry and Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce for the Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the K-bis is issued, retrieve the SIREN, SIRET and NAF/APE code assigned by INSEE. File the beneficial owner declaration (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs) with the Greffe within 30 days of registration and keep it updated. The declaration is a mandatory condition for certain banking and public-contract transactions.
required_dossiers: Identity documents of each natural-person beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the beneficial owner declaration is rejected or filed late, file a corrected declaration immediately with the Greffe; if a penalty has been issued, request voluntary regularisation and invoke the French administrative tolerance for first-time good-faith omissions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) of the Direction Générale des Finances Publiques and URSSAF.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company for corporate income tax (IS), value added tax (VAT) and the business property contribution (cotisation foncière des entreprises) at the competent SIE. For each employee, submit the pre-employment declaration (déclaration préalable à l'embauche) to URSSAF and complete the workplace health-and-safety registration. Request an EU VAT number if intra-community invoicing is contemplated.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VAT or corporate-tax activation is delayed because of incomplete documentation, provide a fresh K-bis and explain any inconsistencies to the SIE in writing; if the SIE rejects a late-filed pre-employment declaration, submit a corrective DPE along with a request for ex tunc effect and pay any minimal administrative fees.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Direction Départementale de l'Emploi, du Travail et des Solidarités (DDETS) for occupational safety and, where a physical container depot is operated, the Direction Régionale et Interdépartementale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et des Transports (DRIEAT) as the inspecting authority under the Minister of Ecological Transition.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registre des Installations Classées pour la Protection de l'Environnement (ICPE) — regime of Déclaration (DC) where container depot storage exceeds regulatory thresholds; otherwise an exemption notice. Also requires a formal workplace conformity certificate under the Code du travail for non-public staff premises.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Inspection des Installations Classées (Ministère de la Transition Écologique) / DRIEAT in the region of activity.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from full EIA Report for pure container box leasing without on-site depot operations. If the operator maintains a storage depot exceeding 300 m³ of container stacking volume, an ICPE Declaration (DC) filing applies; non-ICPE administrative tolerances apply for minimal storage or offices only.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: If a maintenance, cleaning or wash-out facility is operated, comply with the French Order of 2 December 2014 on waste-heap exploitation and the ICPE derogation thresholds: wastewater discharged to sewer containing total suspended solids below 150 mg/L, COD below 300 mg/L, pH between 5.5 and 8.5; volatile organic compounds at workshop exits below 110 mg/Nm³; any solvent waste removed by a registered waste carrier with waste-transfer certificates.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety inspection and certification by the relevant municipal or departmental fire and rescue service for all premises providing workstations; structural load inspection certificate for any container stacking area or racking; and an occupational-employment clearance issued by the DDETS confirming compliance with the Code du travail concerning access to work, evacuation routes, emergency equipment and workplace medical checks.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) – portal: impots.gouv.fr; corporate income tax filings and VAT administration via the local Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity must file a French VAT registration application form (Form 1550-EU-SD) with the competent SIE before commencing taxable supplies. Non-EU entities ordinarily apply through the required French Establishment (déclaration d'établissement) or appoint a tax agent if no permanent establishment exists; the SIE then issues the French TIN and individual VAT number. The SARL itself is obtained by registration at the Centre de Formalités des Entreprises (CFE) with the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce, followed by automatic assignment of the SIRET and VAT identification.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No general check-the-box election exists in France. Tax consolidation (intégration fiscale) is available under Articles 223 A et seq. of the Code Général des Impôts for groups of at least 95% controlled resident companies. Hybrid mismatch elections are not elective; the anti-hybrid rules under ATAD (Articles 210 ter et seq. CGI) apply mandatorily. Certain joint ventures may elect for transparent treatment only in narrow, statute-defined circumstances.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée – TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Domestic small-business thresholds for established French businesses: €85,000 annual turnover for goods and €37,500 for services (franchise en base). Non-established foreign suppliers have no de minimis registration threshold and must register for French VAT before supplying taxable goods or services inside France, subject to OSS simplification for intra-Community distance sales beyond the annual EU-wide threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory B2B e-invoicing applies through the Chorus Pro portal or certified dematerialization platform (Plateforme de Dématérialisation Partenaire) under the progressive schedule applicable from 1 September 2026 for large and medium-sized enterprises and 1 September 2027 for small and mid-sized enterprises, with real-time e-reporting of B2C transaction data and fiscal clearance through reactive data transmission (F format). All invoicing must include compliant QR codes and a regulatory digital signature where required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to goods dispatched or transported outside the European Union under Article 262(I) of the CGI when the supplier holds valid proof of export. For services, zero-rating applies mainly to international transport and directly related services; intermodal container leasing supplied to a non-resident operator for use in international transport may qualify where the service is directly linked to the export or import of goods, provided the recipient is established outside France and the service is not effectively used in the French domestic economy.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading (Connaissement) or AWB / CMR transport document
Inward Remittance Certificate (Avis d'Accréditation / Preuve de paiement en devises)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The tax administration may disregard zero-rating and reassess VAT at 20% if the export documentation is incomplete, inaccurate, or non-contemporaneous. Deliberate concealment or false documentation constitutes tax fraud (fraude fiscale) and triggers a 100% VAT collection penalty (majoration de 100%), interest at 0.20% per month, and a fine of €750,000 plus imprisonment for executive officers under Article 1741 CGI. Export refund claims falsely substantiated are automatically clawed back with penalties and may trigger criminal prosecution.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Central Bank of France) and European Central Bank (ECB)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France operates under full capital account convertibility as an EU member state with no restrictions on profit remittances subject to corporate tax compliance and beneficial ownership declarations. Current account transactions benefit from automatic convertibility via authorized intermediaries with no capital controls applicable to resident French entities.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export receipts must be surrendered to an authorized bank within one month of receipt, converted to EUR at the official ECB reference rate, with supporting documentation required for repatriation including commercial invoices, transport documents, and proof of delivery.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Limited viability due to stringent French EMI regulations under AMF and ECB oversight; offshore digital EMIs face licensing barriers and AML compliance mandates rendering cross-border operations non-compliant for French entities.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of directors or authorized signatories is generally required for initial KYC onboarding at French commercial banks, though remote video verification may be permitted in limited cases following enhanced due diligence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Ultimate beneficial owner identification forms, corporate organigram, and source of funds documentation

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Leasing asset verification and payment flows
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: ISO container registration certificates, lease agreements, insurance policies, and historical transaction records
Enhanced due diligence reports and legal opinions confirming no exposure to restricted jurisdictions

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound wires via SWIFT MT103 with purpose code 'EQUITY CONTRIBUTION' or 'CAPITAL INJECTION', accompanied by board resolutions, ownership transfer documents, and tax clearance certificates for verification.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlements routed through SWIFT MT103 for lease payments or commercial letters of credit for structured settlements, with full documentation including invoices, delivery proofs, and regulatory compliance attestations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual statutory accounts filing (liasse fiscale + balance sheet, P&L, notes, management report) with the Commercial Court Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Tribunal de commerce / judicial court registry), transmitted via the Guichet Électronique des Formalités
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholder approval within six months of fiscal year-end; annual accounts must be deposited with the registry within one month of approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing: formal injunction from the public prosecutor, potential fine up to EUR 1,500 per failure, and possible administrative strike-off if filing remains delinquent beyond regulatory grace periods; legal representative may be disqualified or held personally liable for uncovered liabilities.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (déclaration de résultat n°2065 and schedules 2050/2051) including application of the standard 25% corporate income tax rate and declaration of the differential tax base
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), service des impôts des entreprises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the second business day after 1 May following the fiscal year-end (for calendar-year filers); electronic filing is compulsory for SARL taxpayers exceeding the size threshold
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 5% of deferred tax amount plus monthly 0.6% late-payment interest (intérêt de retard); automatic 10% increase in net tax after 45 days; persistent failure may trigger tax audit and time-bar suspension of statute of limitations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of Beneficial Owner (UBO) declaration and update of any changes in direct or indirect ownership of 25%+ of capital or voting rights
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (RCS registry; filed together with annual accounts)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At each annual accounts filing; within 15 days of any change in beneficial ownership or economic interest
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or update UBO declaration: fine up to EUR 7,500 for natural persons and EUR 37,500 for legal entities, potential imprisonment for deliberate concealment, and administrative strike-off risk after repeated failure to comply with registry orders.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of corporate domiciliation / registered office address and judicial publication of yearly financial statements summary in BODACC
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce and BODACC (Bulletin Officiel des Annonces Civiles et Commerciales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Concurrent with annual accounts filing; publication obligation arises after deposit of accounts; all registered particulars must be updated within one month of any change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-publication of accounts: criminal indemnity up to EUR 10,000 plus publication order; inconsistency in registered address may trigger administrative injunctions and inability to perfect corporate bank and litigation formalities.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory appointment of a statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) for an SARL if at the end of the fiscal year it exceeds at least two of the following thresholds for two consecutive years: total balance sheet EUR 4,000,000; net turnover excluding tax EUR 8,000,000; average number of employees 50. Groups controlling subsidiaries above certain size thresholds are also subject to mandatory group audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général, regulated ANC regulations applicable to private entities); consolidated financial statements, if prepared, may opt for IFRS for public-interest entities but individual SARL accounts remain under French GAAP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SARL must, at the time of annual accounts filing, reconfirm the exact identity, nationality, date of birth, registered address, nature and percentages of ownership in the capital and voting rights of every beneficial owner holding directly or indirectly at least 25% of the company's capital, in the standard declaration filed with the Greffe. Any shareholding transfer triggering a change must be declared within 15 days. The registry retains the UBO file for public inspection (unless confidentiality invoked in documentary cases).

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 250 - 600 per year for a professional registered office address and corporate secretarial administration
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 4,000 - 12,000 per year for a small to mid-sized SARL when statutory audit is triggered; no audit fee if exemption thresholds are met

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 15% reduced rate for SMEs (annual turnover < €50 million and < 50 employees); specific tax incentives for R&D investments, innovation tax credit, and certain asset acquisitions

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 1200 - Déclaration de résultat (impôt sur les sociétés) filed electronically via impots.gouv.fr
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 3 months after the end of the fiscal year (31 March for calendar-year fiscal year)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable profit or loss before adjustments and deductions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident entities report only French-source income; provide supporting documentation for any deductions claimed on French-source profits

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Allowable provisions, depreciation, and other deductions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents must substantiate all deductions with invoices and contracts; foreign exchange adjustments require transfer pricing compliance

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 - Impôt sur les sociétés due
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For non-resident leasing entities, calculate tax only on French-source income; attach TRC if treaty relief claimed

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: €250 per month late filing (maximum €7,500); 0.5% per month of unpaid tax; plus statutory interest on late payments

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 12.8% (reduced to 0% for qualifying EU/EEA parent companies under the Parent-Subsidiary Directive)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Submit TRC (Traitement de la demande de réduction de retenue à la source) to French tax authorities with ownership proof, beneficial ownership certificate, and treaty documentation; processing typically 6-12 months
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 25% statutory rate, reduced to 0-10% under most treaties (e.g., US-France 0-5%); Interest: 25% statutory rate, reduced to 0% under arm's-length debt treaties (e.g., US-France 0% if conditions met)

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: €50 million annual turnover for mandatory local file and master file requirements
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: French Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) apply to container leasing activities; requires adequate physical presence, core income-generating activities, and qualified employees in France to support tax residency and avoid denial of benefits

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate understatement of taxable income or false statements in the corporate tax return
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalty of up to 5 years imprisonment and fine up to €500,000 or 80% of the evaded tax amount
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal criminal liability, imprisonment, civil restitution orders, and potential disqualification from corporate offices

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a French SARL without sufficient substance for container leasing operations (e.g., no local employees or management)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative penalties up to €10,000 per infraction; potential loss of tax residency status and denial of treaty benefits
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal civil liability for damages caused, possible management disqualification, and entry bans

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to prepare or file local file/master file documentation or apply arm's length principle to intra-group leasing charges
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalties of 80% of the understated tax or €10,000 minimum; plus interest and potential restitution
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal civil liability and potential criminal charges if intent to evade is proven

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to report cross-border transactions or maintain adequate documentation for dividend/royalty flows
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to €1 million or 5% of annual turnover; criminal sanctions possible
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Imprisonment up to 5 years, substantial fines, and travel restrictions
